# localclaw

> Documentation for localclaw, organised with the Diátaxis framework: tutorials teach, how-to guides solve tasks, reference states facts, explanation builds understanding. Every Markdown page begins with a YAML frontmatter preamble (title, description, diataxis, status, last_reviewed) so tools can classify it without reading the body.

Contributor and agent rules live in AGENTS.md at the repository root: work in a git worktree, land every change through a pull request, use Conventional Commits, follow Diátaxis for documentation, and version releases with Semantic Versioning. Read it before changing anything.

Paths below are relative to this file. No code has landed yet, so tutorials and product reference are still empty. The documentation system itself is fully documented.

## Start here

- [LocalClaw README](../README.md): What LocalClaw is, the three-machine architecture and network model, the lclaw CLI, and where to find docs and contributor rules.
- [Documentation](README.md): Entry point to the localclaw docs: how the Diátaxis layout works and how to find or add the right kind of page.
- [Contributor rules](../AGENTS.md): Worktree, pull request, commit message, documentation and release requirements for agents and humans.

## Tutorials

- [Tutorials](tutorials/README.md): Index of learning-oriented lessons. A tutorial takes a newcomer through a complete exercise that is guaranteed to work.

## How-to guides

- [How-to guides](how-to/README.md): Index of task-oriented guides. A how-to guide gives a competent reader the steps to accomplish one real goal.
- [Add a document](how-to/add-a-document.md): Create a page in the right Diátaxis section, fill in the frontmatter, and register it in the indexes so agents can find it.

## Reference

- [Reference](reference/README.md): Index of reference material. Reference pages describe the machinery accurately and austerely, structured to mirror what they describe.
- [Frontmatter schema](reference/frontmatter-schema.md): Fields, types and allowed values for the YAML preamble that begins every Markdown page under docs/.
- [llms.txt index format](reference/llms-txt.md): Location, structure and entry format of docs/llms.txt, the curated index that lets agents find pages without reading every file.

## Explanation

- [Explanation](explanation/README.md): Index of understanding-oriented discussion. Explanation pages say why things are the way they are, with context, trade-offs and alternatives.
- [Why Diátaxis](explanation/why-diataxis.md): The reasoning behind the four-way split, and how frontmatter and llms.txt make that structure discoverable by agents.
- [CLI architecture](explanation/cli-architecture.md): Why lclaw is layered as presentation, domain and data, which dependencies it accepts, and how the doctor command proves the design.

## Optional

- [Document templates](_templates/README.md): Copyable skeletons, one per Diátaxis type, with placeholder frontmatter and a commented body outline.
